title: Tabuun Universe - Characters
subtitle: Illustrations of magical characters for the design of a narrative universe.
description:
Tabuun Universe is a personal project that consists of the creation of a complete universe: with its own worldbuilding, characters, power system and multiple stories that intertwine within a vast cosmos of action and magic.

I generated illustrations of several characters that I imagined for this universe, some more detailed and others in sketch format, in order to quickly represent their personality, role and essence within the world I have been imagining.
